=== vi-prop-metric
card vi-prop-metric  [decided]
The Flow tab shows how many reviews by you confirmed a card unchanged
why: It is the measure for the kill criterion of #vi-prop: when most of your reviews change nothing, the marks are noise. An unchanged confirm by the agent is the normal case, so it is shown but not counted. The number comes from the log, not from a hand count.

- A review counts only if the card was stale at that moment, and you made it.
- An amend counts as changed. A confirm counts as unchanged.
- The threshold, window, and minimum sample come from #vi-prop's kill criterion.
- The gauge follows the Flow scope, so a subtree shows its own share.
- Colour follows the state: red fires, green holds, grey not enough data.

       why: The gauge is a section of the Flow tab from #vi-flowtab and follows its scope.
=== lp-overseer-psfail-metric
card lp-overseer-psfail-metric  [decided]
The Flow tab shows the share of process probe samples that failed
why: It is the measure for the metric kill criterion of #lp-overseer-psfail. When the probe fails often, more passes run blind to the wall-clock cap. The number comes from the pass event streams, not from a hand count.

- Each pass records how many probe samples it took and how many of them failed. The probe samples only while a tool call runs.
- The share is the failed samples over all samples, summed over the passes in the window.
- The threshold, window, and minimum sample come from the metric kill criterion of #lp-overseer-psfail.
- The gauge shows when the Flow scope contains #lp-overseer-psfail. Probe samples belong to passes, not to cards, so every scope that shows the gauge counts every pass.
- Colour follows the state: red fires, green holds, grey not enough data.

card kill  [decided]
Every decision carries kill criteria: what must become true to revisit it
why: The author sets the revisit trigger when the decision is made. A later challenge only checks that trigger, so a challenge has a low social cost. A machine-checkable trigger lets a background agent watch the decision, like an SLO alert on a decision.
card ms-self  [open]
Measure the pipeline's cost, failures and escapes, to choose how to change the pipeline
why: A product measure says whether one feature works. It does not say which stage, gate or model to change. Only measures of the pipeline itself can compare two pipeline designs.
card ms-store  [decided]
One append-only pipeline log holds every step's start, end, and cost
why: The metrics and the debugging trace come from the same facts: when each step started and ended, what it cost, and how it ended. One event log with one fold serves both, in the same shape as the decision log and the board log.
card visual  [decided]
